Explicit analytic prerequisite restatement:
E has the same full-space finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel structure, including dimension zero. V is C2 with true all-point/all-direction alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I, alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, eta>0 and beta eta<=1.
The original Gibbs law, genuine independent Gaussian augmentation, selected R,S kernels, reflected W_y, finite positive partition and fixed original gradient D per fiber are derived by the existing actual conditional producer. Neither normalization nor a convenient replacement operator is supplied.
The potential is reflected, with quarter Hessian scaling. The unreflected SPHMC RGO potential/law is different. Existence is fiberwise for every y; no joint measurable resolvent selection, unbounded cost transfer or macroscopic H1/Poincare theorem is asserted.
For actual C2 V with 0<alpha<=beta global Hessian bounds, eta>0 and beta eta<=1, construct the actual Gibbs-Gaussian augmentation and common Markov conditional kernels R,S, with disintegration R and S_y=(R_y)#(x->2x-y). S_y is the true normalized reflected Gibbs law for W_y(u)=V((y+u)/2)+norm(u-y)^2/(8eta), with C2 regularity and positive integrable weight. For every y, retain one dense closable exact compact-smooth gradient D, fixed before epsilon/input, and derive every positive-epsilon L2 forcing weak solution, ordinary weak gradient/local integrability and all C1 compact weighted volume test equations. No measurable solution selection in y is claimed.
Same actual compact-gradient graph closure admits C1 compact function/gradient pairs; actual positive-epsilon weak resolvent has all C1 compact weighted volume tests and genuine ordinary weak gradient. Actual PBPS reflected conditional R/S law and original fixed D precede epsilon/input. No local H2, global operator-core/Bochner, conditional Poincare/BL, centered epsilon limit, noncompact constant/linear domains, measurable y-selection, SPHMC Hessian lower/full4.1, PBPS hypocoercivity or either complete main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
          Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W y x) * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * ψ x)) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W y x) * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) (gradient ψ x)) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W y x) * (f x * ψ x)) ∧
          ε * (∫ x, Real.exp (-W y x) * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * ψ x)) +
            (∫ x, Real.exp (-W y x) * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) (gradient ψ x)) =
            ∫ x, Real.exp (-W y x) * (f x * ψ x)

Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, equipped with its Borel measurable space and canonical Lebesgue measure dx; dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E->R and alpha,beta be nonnegative real scalars and eta a real scalar. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, V is C2, and, for every x,v in E,
  alpha*||v||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x v) v <= beta*||v||^2.
Assume eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Define
  mu = volume.tilted(x -> -V(x)),
  J = map((x,g) -> (x,x+sqrt(eta)*g), mu.prod(stdGaussian E)),
  W_y(z) = V((y+z)/2) + ||z-y||^2/(8*eta).
Here volume.tilted(-F) is the volume measure with density exp(-F)/integral exp(-F); the Gaussian/product/pushforward are the actual measures.
There exist kernels R,S:E->Measure E with all the following properties: R and S are Markov kernels; R is a conditional kernel for J.map Prod.swap, disintegrating the swapped joint (Y,X); and for every y in E, S(y) is the pushforward of R(y) under x -> 2*x-y.
For every y in E, S(y)=volume.tilted(z -> -W_y(z)), W_y is C2, exp(-W_y) is Lebesgue integrable, and its Lebesgue integral is strictly positive. Moreover, for this y there exists a real-linear partial operator
  D:L2(S(y);R) -> L2(S(y);E)
whose domain is dense in L2(S(y);R), which is closable and whose closure is closed, and whose graph is characterized exactly as follows: for every a in L2(S(y);R) and H in L2(S(y);E),
  (a,H) belongs to graph(D) iff there exists phi:E->R that is smooth and has compact support, with a=phi S(y)-almost everywhere and H=gradient(phi) S(y)-almost everywhere.
For this same D, for every real epsilon>0 and every f in L2(S(y);R), there exists u in domain(D.closure) satisfying all the following conclusions simultaneously. Write u_rep and f_rep for the usual representatives of the scalar L2 classes, and G_rep for the usual representative of G=D.closure(u) in L2(S(y);E).
(1) For every v in domain(D.closure),
  epsilon*<u,v>_{L2(S(y);R)} + <D.closure(u),D.closure(v)>_{L2(S(y);E)} = <f,v>_{L2(S(y);R)}.
(2) u_rep and G_rep are locally integrable with respect to Lebesgue volume.
(3) For every C1 compactly supported psi:E->R and every direction v in E, both x -> psi(x)*<G_rep(x),v>_E and x -> u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x v) are Lebesgue integrable and
  integral psi(x)*<G_rep(x),v>_E dx = - integral u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x v) dx.
(4) For every C1 compactly supported psi:E->R, all three functions
  x -> exp(-W_y(x))*(u_rep(x)*psi(x)),
  x -> exp(-W_y(x))*<G_rep(x),gradient(psi)(x)>_E,
  x -> exp(-W_y(x))*(f_rep(x)*psi(x))
are Lebesgue integrable, and
  epsilon*integral exp(-W_y(x))*(u_rep(x)*psi(x)) dx
  + integral exp(-W_y(x))*<G_rep(x),gradient(psi)(x)>_E dx
  = integral exp(-W_y(x))*(f_rep(x)*psi(x)) dx.
One pair of kernels R,S works for all y. For each y one D is chosen before epsilon and f, and works for all of them. For each epsilon and f the same u serves every variational test v, every directional weak-gradient test, and every weighted test psi. The Hilbert inner products use S(y), whereas all local-integrability assertions, directional weak-gradient integrals, partition integrals, and the final weighted test integrals use Lebesgue volume. The displayed weighted equation uses exp(-W_y) without dividing by its partition integral. The conclusions about S(y), W_y, and D hold for every y, not merely almost every y; the conditional-kernel conclusion itself has its usual disintegration meaning.

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalGradient
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedResolventC1

/-!
# Actual C1 compact weak-resolvent tests

Actual PBPS common conditional kernels and reflected potential with the same original gradient D before epsilon/input. Genuine C1 compact weighted weak equations and ordinary weak gradient are produced. The law is reflected, with quarter curvature; it is not the unreflected SPHMC RGO law. Fiberwise existence is not measurable y-selection, H2, global Bochner, Poincare, hypocoercivity or paper completion.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalC1Resolvent
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory InnerProductSpace
open scoped ContDiff NNReal RealInnerProductSpace Topology
noncomputable section

theorem conditional_c1_resolvent {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α:ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, (α:ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β:ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β:ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
    let W := fun y u : E => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
    ∃ R S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel R ∧ IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (J.map Prod.swap).IsCondKernel R ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (R y).map (fun x => (2:ℝ) • x-y)) ∧
      ∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun u => -W y u) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧ Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        0 < (∫ u, Real.exp (-W y u)) ∧
        ∃ D : Lp ℝ 2 (S y) →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 (S y),
          Dense (D.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 (S y))) ∧ D.IsClosable ∧ D.closure.IsClosed ∧
          (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) (v : Lp E 2 (S y)), (u,v) ∈ D.graph ↔
            ∃ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
              u =ᵐ[S y] f ∧ v =ᵐ[S y] gradient f) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 (S y),
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)), (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 (S y))⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
          Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W y x) * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * ψ x)) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W y x) * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) (gradient ψ x)) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W y x) * (f x * ψ x)) ∧
          ε * (∫ x, Real.exp (-W y x) * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 (S y)) x * ψ x)) +
            (∫ x, Real.exp (-W y x) * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) (gradient ψ x)) =
            ∫ x, Real.exp (-W y x) * (f x * ψ x) := by
  obtain ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,hfiber⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalGradient.conditional_gradient_closable hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨R,S,hR,hS,hcond,hSR,?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph⟩ := hfiber y
  refine ⟨hSy,hW,hI,hZ,D,hDense,hClose,hClosed,hgraph,?_⟩
  intro ε hε f
  let Wy : E → ℝ := fun u => V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) + ‖u-y‖^2/(8*η)
  have hW1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 Wy := hW.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hwc := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedResolventC1.weak_resolvent_c1 Wy hW1 hI
  dsimp only at hwc
  rw [← hSy] at hwc
  exact hwc D hClose hgraph ε hε f

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ConditionalC1Resolvent
